exposure: Copy number variations (CNVs) involving FOXG1 gene
outcome: Underdevelopment of frontal and temporal lobes
cohort: A female child with a de novo nonsense mutation of FOXG1 and twelve Chinese children with FOXG1-related encephalopathy.
finding: This study identified a novel FOXG1 mutation in a Chinese child with neurodevelopmental disorders and analyzed 12 cases with FOXG1 mutations, revealing common clinical features and suggesting PRKD1 as a potential cooperating factor in RTT/RTT-like disorders.
